svg.title: The same nine numbers, at every position
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The same nine numbers, at every position” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A three-by-three kernel drawn over a five-by-five grid and again one step to the right with a dashed trail, filling two cells of a feature map, beside a struck-out fully-connected alternative at 77,070,336 parameters against the convolution's 896; below, an eight-stage shape ladder from 3 by 224 by 224 to four classes through global average pooling, and a plain block whose layer-one gradient is 2.1e-5 beside a residual block with an identity arc whose layer-one gradient is 4.3e-3, 205 times larger.
svg.text: The same nine numbers, at every position
draw it from memory, then compare
